_comment: Gameplay QA inventory. Every gameplay system must be listed here with at least one automated test or an explicit gap; Tools/check_qa_inventory.py scans the sources (UCLASS/UINTERFACE classes, Core headers, Spn.* console commands, Default*Key bindings) and fails when something is not listed. Add new features here when you add them (the QA script refuses to run otherwise). Regenerate Docs/Development/Gameplay-QA-Inventory.md with: check_qa_inventory.py --write
ignore_note: Variant_* are the Unreal template sample variants (Combat, Platforming, SideScrolling): not SPN gameplay, not part of the SPN game modes, neither used nor tested here.

entries.title: Gaits Walk/Jog/Run/Sprint, acceleration, braking, gait cycle and sprint keys
entries.gap: Gamepad sprint (DefaultSprintGamepadKey) and analog stick magnitudes through a real gamepad are not tested; speeds are the current placeholder values, not approved tuning.

entries.title: Direction changes, 90/180 degree turns, sprint left/right
entries.gap: The steering model of the Core (GroundSteering) is not wired into the Unreal movement yet; SprintTurn fails until that decision is made (see Docs/Development/M2A2-Windows-Integration-Report.md).

entries.title: Jump: standing, moving, sprint, ledges, collisions, landing
entries.gap: Jump key is bound by the template's IMC_Default asset (Space), exercised through SpnQA.Jump but not inventoried as a C++ binding; coyote time / jump buffering do not exist.

entries.title: Obstacles, steps, stairs and ramps
entries.gap: Obstacles and StairsAndRamps fail today (walking over 30 cm ledges, 30 cm stairs); a capsule/step decision by the developer is open.

entries.title: Sprint/gait prediction and replay for network play
entries.gap: No real multi-client session with latency is run; co-op networking is not designed yet.

entries.title: Opt-in movement frame recorder (spn.MoveDiag)
entries.gap: Developer tool; measured through the report tests, no pass/fail assertion on the recorder format itself.

entries.title: Play-area guard and reset points
Follow camera: collision, arm recovery, mesh hiding, tight spaces
entries.gap: Camera look input (mouse/stick sensitivity) and field-of-view behaviour are not tested; there is no automated visual comparison of what the camera shows.

entries.title: Interaction trace, reach and the E key
entries.gap: No on-screen prompt or highlight exists, so nothing visible to test; interaction through a gamepad button is not bound. InteractionSystem V2 (selection, statuses, cooldowns, links, events) is Core only and not yet used by USpnInteractionComponent; no Unreal test of it exists.

entries.title: Doors: open/close via E, swing, collision, persistence
entries.gap: Locked doors have no key model; door sound/animation are placeholders. Closing onto a player: the Core decides through a block rule, but the Unreal overlap query (ASpnTestDoor) is written without a build and NOT verified; doors vs NPCs are not tested.

entries.title: Pickups and inventories
entries.gap: The V2 level contains no pickups (they live in the M1 test maps); there is no inventory UI.

entries.title: World state (facts), save and load
entries.gap: Player position/character state, a save menu, quick-save and autosave do not exist (reported as NOT_IMPLEMENTED by SpnQA.SaveLoad). Object-state persistence (changed-state records, regions, atomic files) is Core only and not wired to USpnWorldStateSubsystem.

entries.title: Game mode, player controller, PlayerStart and single player pawn
entries.gap: NPC pawns do not exist in the Unreal project yet (SpnQA.Spawn reports npc_vs_player as NOT_IMPLEMENTED); local split-screen/co-op spawning is not designed.

entries.title: Map V2 generator output, instancing and buildings
entries.gap: Window gaps, street crossings and lighting are only checked visually (screenshots/video); load time and editor viewport performance are not measured. The opt-in enriched level (Lvl_SpnMovementTestV2Env, spn_env_enrichment.py) exists only as generator data and Fedora-side geometry validation; nothing of it was generated or seen in Unreal (see Docs/Development/M2A3-Environment-Visual-Checklist.md).

entries.title: Frame time, draw calls, memory
entries.gap: No approved performance budget exists; SpnQA.Performance uses a placeholder (30 FPS average, worst frame below 100 ms).

entries.title: NPC, appearance, detail tiers and content ids (engine-independent Core only)
entries.gap: These Core modules are not integrated in the Unreal game, so there is no in-game test; the Core tests are CMake/CTest tests (Fedora) and are NOT run by the Windows QA script.

entries.title: Switch, button, lever and links (Core foundation)
entries.gap: No Unreal actors or components exist for these devices; nothing is visible in a level. Only Core behavior is tested.

entries.title: World map domain: layers, regions, points of interest, markers, discovery, spatial queries (Core foundation, M2B1)
entries.gap: Not integrated in the Unreal game: no map data (the world geometry will come from SPN WorldForge), no UI and no save-game wiring; only Core behavior is tested on Fedora and is NOT run by the Windows QA script.

entries.title: Minimap calculations: world-to-screen transform, rotation modes, viewport clipping, off-screen indicators (Core foundation, M2B1)
entries.gap: Produces data only; no widget renders it and no Unreal coordinate adapter exists (axis mapping to Unreal is still to be defined). Only Core behavior is tested.

entries.title: Inventory domain: item definitions, stacks, containers, capacity, equipment slots, transactions (Core foundation, M2B1)
entries.gap: Not integrated in the Unreal game and not connected to the placeholder pickup counts (Pickup.h); no item data, no UI. Transactions use an undo log (M2B2). Only Core behavior is tested.

entries.title: Navigation domain: destinations, route data model, route validation and measurement (Core foundation, M2B1)
entries.gap: Data model only: no pathfinding and no road graph (both come from WorldForge / Unreal navigation); nothing is shown in the game. Only Core behavior is tested.

entries.title: Canonical world coordinates and adapters: metres/east-north-up, Unreal centimetre axis presets, local frames, map and minimap (Core foundation, M2B2)
entries.gap: The Unreal axis mapping is a PROPOSAL (master: open, WF-DC01 / CQ-101) and has never been run in Unreal or checked against WorldForge output; no Unreal adapter code uses it yet. Only Core behavior is tested.

entries.title: Unified save slot: versioned sections, checksums, atomic publication with previous generation, game-state adapters (Core foundation, M2B2)
entries.gap: Not wired into the Unreal game (the game still uses its own save console commands); the Windows file-flush path is written but unverified; crash safety is tested by fault injection only, never against a real power loss. Only Core behavior is tested.
